controls.summary: Use the device editor for operating rules and machine interactions; movement remains available. Escape pauses.

objective: Defend the castle through 3 waves, upgrade a defence. Place towers beside the route; farms fund your kingdom.
title: Kingdom Circuit
subtitle: The Watchtower
learning_objectives: Learn the platform controls, missions and progression.
Discuss the institute and college VMGO, PILOs and CILOs using instructor-provided statements.
win_condition: Operate the mission's required device ports using the instruction editor, then: Survive every wave with the castle standing and complete the economy and upgrade targets.
lose_condition: The castle loses all health or the 600-second time limit expires before completion.
hint: Program the controller, run it, inspect the live input/output and revise rejected operations. INTERACT requires an eligible nearby port.
